description: The Echelon's emergency address — seizes every tuned set in Architect when the special MediaDeck goes to air.

messages.text: All programming has been suspended. This is a message from the Echelon.
Remain where you are. The Architect is aware of your situation.
Do not attempt to leave the district. Do not attempt to interfere.
Normal service will resume when it is permitted to resume.
Compliance is appreciated. This has been a message from the Echelon.

name: Echelon Emergency Address
